@copilot assertDurationMetric method already has an internal check and only applies to emitStableDatabaseSemconv, so this can be simplified to just `DB_QUERY_SUMMARY`

make this change in instrumentation/cassandra/cassandra-4-common/testing/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/cassandra/v4/common/AbstractCassandraTest.java too

replies.body: Simplified in c2016059. Removed the conditional and unused `DB_OPERATION_NAME` imports from both files since `assertDurationMetric` only runs when `emitStableDatabaseSemconv()` is true.

maybe operation and collection name should be captured, does Cassandra support multiple operation and collection names in non-batch operations?

> The operation name SHOULD NOT be extracted from `db.query.text`, when the database system supports query text with multiple operations in non-batch operations.

and

> The collection name SHOULD NOT be extracted from `db.query.text`, when the database system supports query text with multiple collections in non-batch operations.

replies.body: maybe, but there are too many databases to comb through details, so my suggestion is that we just do simple application of the rules for 3.0, and if/when there is interest in a specific database later on, we can refine it
